title: 👑 Premium & a Secret Scratch Card!
message: Get everything in the game with one payment, and scratch the gold card for a special surprise deal.
points: 👑 Premium: Pay once and it's yours forever. No monthly payments.
🎨 All Trains: Every metro livery and the longest trains are open with Premium.
🏗️ Build Without Limits: Make as many lines and metros as you like.
🎟️ Scratch & Win: Scratch the gold card on the Premium page to reveal a secret deal.
⏱️ 1-Hour Deal: Your deal lasts 1 hour after you scratch it, so don't miss it!
🔄 Restore Purchases: Changed your phone? Get your Premium back in one tap.
🔔 What's New: This window shows you every new feature when you update.
🛠️ Small Fixes: Smoother trip endings and better stability.

title: 🚇 Welcome to Metro Driver India!
message: Drive real Indian metro lines on viaducts, at street level and deep underground.
points: 🗺️ City Metros: Delhi, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata and more.
🎨 32 Liveries: Pick your train and set its length.
🏗️ Metro Builder: Make your own lines with interchanges and share them.
🔊 Announcements: Next station calls in English and Hindi.
🌧️ Live Conditions: Day and night, clouds and rain.
